source.name: CSS frameworks and styling tools (GitHub)
source.license: Repository metadata (description, stars, license, topics) from GitHub via the GitHub REST API; each library keeps its own license (field license). Discovery lists: brillout/awesome-react-components (CC0-1.0); vuejs/awesome-vue (MIT); birobirobiro/awesome-shadcn-ui (MIT); jondot/awesome-react-native (no license file); Solido/awesome-flutter (no license file); PatrickJS/awesome-angular (CC0-1.0); web-padawan/awesome-web-components (CC0-1.0); aniftyco/awesome-tailwindcss (CC0-1.0).
source.note: Found via hand-picked seeds, awesome-list sections and GitHub topic search (live). Kept: seeds always; awesome-list repos with ≥300 stars; topic repos with ≥1000 stars; forks and archived repos dropped unless hand-picked. metrics.downloads = last-month downloads of the repo's most-downloaded npm/pub package (packages.ecosyste.ms); use.install = that package unless the official docs command was hand-copied.
